_llm_instructions: Fill out 'project_title' and 'date_prepared', and the 'value' property of each field, using the project context. Use 'label' to select the correct output language. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

contract_identification.label: Contract Identification
contract_identification.guidance: Record the contract reference, the vendor, and the contract type and value.

change_id.label: Change ID
change_id.guidance: Enter the change identifier from the change log.

change_description.label: Change Description
change_description.guidance: Enter the description from the change log.

date_approved.label: Date Approved
date_approved.guidance: Enter the date approved from the change log.

dispute_description.label: Dispute Description
dispute_description.guidance: The dispute or claim, what was in contention, and the amount or scope at issue. State the position the project took and the date it was raised, because a dispute recorded without its date cannot be distinguished from one still open at closeout.

dispute_resolution.label: Resolution
dispute_resolution.guidance: How the dispute was settled, by whom, and when, with a reference to the agreement or settlement that closed it. An unresolved dispute carried past closeout is a liability the receiving organisation inherits without knowing it, so record the outcome even when it is only partial.

date_resolved.label: Date Resolved
date_resolved.guidance: Enter the date the dispute or claim was resolved.

completion_date.label: Contract Completion Date
completion_date.guidance: The date the contract was completed, meaning the date the work was accepted rather than the date the last invoice was paid. Where the two differ, give both, because a payment date is not evidence that the work was accepted.

signed_off_by.label: Signed Off By
signed_off_by.guidance: Record who signed off on the contract completion.

final_payment_date.label: Final Payment Date
final_payment_date.guidance: Enter the date of the final payment.

comments.label: Comments
comments.guidance: Add any comments that will add relevance to the closeout report.
